Dear Mr. Jeffrey

EFTA01028303

 We take note of your last 2 emails (the below and attached), in which you expressed your dissatisfaction regarding the
last Presentation that took place in Paris on the 23rd of January 2019.

It is with great astonishment; and without emotions, we take note of your comments especially after our last productive
and positive meeting in Paris.

We do not question your mode of expression nor your approach but rather respect it. However, we consider it as
subjective — In Design there is nothing called "Nice' or "Ugly" it is not Engineering or Mathematics where 1 + 1 = 2.
Imagine if Frank Lloyd Wright presented the "Falling Water" House (copy attached) and it was rejected. This most
important house would have never been built. We want to build you a house to the same level as the "Falling Water".

We wish to clarify few points and propose to you a Strategy for the future if you still wish to continue working with us:

1- Our current involvement is Master Plan with proposed Architecture Character and Space Program considering the
Project Constraints.

In good will; and in order to resolve Major Site Constraints and to define the Client's Requirements, we went way
beyond our contractual obligations and provided you in our last presentation the following:
- Our Initial Developed Architectural Concept/Approach
- Two Alternative Architectural Concepts/Approaches
- As-Built Site 3D Model
- 3 Optional 3D massing Studies.

We developed all the options to open up all the possible approach of the site development and not to resolve small
details like adding a window or enlarging a room. We believe that the main points like General Buildings Locations,
General Program, General Building Views, General Requirements are been met with minor exceptions.

This made us incur losses and costs that exceed our total contract value.

2- In the last presentation Xavier noted clearly that these Options (especially the third option) needs further
development and this presentation is to agree on a the General Design Approach.

3- We were expecting after this last meeting, that you chose One General Scheme / Option and based on which we
can start the Design Development Phase (with a New Higher Level Detailed Scope of Work, Involvement and
Contract) to cover the following tasks:
- Design Development of One Architectural Option
- Interior Design and Landscape Design Concept Design and further Detailed Design

EFTA01028304

 - Engaging Engineering Office to work in parallel with us on the Project Design Development (Geotechnical, MEP,
